title: CTCV J2056-3014 X-ray timing: code and data products
description:
Code and data products for the X-ray timing analysis in Miao et al., Precision X-ray Timing Methods and Spin Evolution Modeling for the Rapidly Rotating Cataclysmic Variable CTCV J2056-3014. The archive holds the Z2 periodogram and pulse-profile notebooks, the scripts that make times of arrival, the five-Gaussian pulse template, the times of arrival, the timing models including the fitted ephemeris (data/timing_model_final.par), and the paper figures they produce. README.md describes the layout and how to reproduce the results, and data/README.md describes each data file.

The spin evolution code is not included. It remains proprietary and is owned by Sudip Bhattacharyya and Sayantan Bhattacharya.

Data sources: XMM-Newton ObsIDs 0842570101 and 0902500101 (XMM-Newton Science Archive); NICER ObsIDs 4592010200, 4592010300 and 7656010100 and NuSTAR ObsID 30801006002 (HEASARC).
